items.context: @sminston_with (49.617 seguidores), en inglés: midió los días que BTC cerró bajo el piso de la power law recalculado en tiempo real en cada bear market: 2015: 210, 2022: 193, 2026: 153 hasta ahora; en 2015 y 2022 el precio volvió sobre el piso y luego hizo máximos. Cuenta mediana con post despegando: ~23 min, 1.581 vistas, 20 likes, 5 guardados, 4 respuestas. Ángulo: power law (ajuste en tiempo real vs. ajuste original de 2013).
items.suggested_text:
The real-time detail is what makes this worth looking at. Most power law charts are fitted with hindsight, so every past bear market seems to respect a floor that, at the time, sat somewhere else. Measured the way it was revealed day by day, 153 days vs 210 and 193 is a much fairer comparison.

A useful cross-check runs the other way: freeze an old fit and see how it aged. Dacoinminster's original 2013 power law, never refitted, had the 2017 top at 9.4× the curve and the 2018 low below it. Put next to a refitted floor, it shows how much of "the floor" depends on when you draw it. https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122317683030941979

And if each cycle's excess above the curve keeps shrinking, it's fair to wonder whether the time spent below it will shrink the same way.
